data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate included an overall prior-period release incorporated into the 2016 underwriting result of GBP 39.8m. This net release was driven by favourable claims development overall, although there were notable offsetting prior-period strengthenings (the report cites a GBP 23.0m prior period strengthening arising from adverse attritional experience and large loss development). Separately, the post-year-end Ogden discount rate change increased gross IBNR by GBP 53.9m (net GBP 30.3m), principally affecting the P&C (motor/liability) portfolios. Current-year catastrophe losses (eg. Hurricane Matthew and Space X) also contributed to the year's claims activity.
raw_causal_phrases: The underwriting loss includes releases from reserves established in prior years of GBP 39.8 million (2015: GBP 38.3 million).

The claims ratio increased to 62% (2015: 50%) as a consequence of catastrophe activity (Hurricane Matthew GBP 3.8 million and Space X GBP 4.1 million) together with GBP 23.0 million of prior period reserve strengthening, resulting from adverse attritional experience and material large loss development.

The announcement had a significant effect on the value of future claims for UK motor and liability insurance. The impact of the Ogden rate change for the Syndicate was a GBP 53.9 million increase in Gross IBNR (all in the P&C SBU) and a net impact of GBP 30.3 million.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year movement was taken from the managing agent narrative which explicitly states a GBP 39.8m release; the report does not present a clear single-line gross 'movement in prior years' table with an unambiguous gross insurance-liabilities figure. A claims development table is present in the notes (page 32) but the scan of the table is difficult to parse programmatically; therefore the reported prior-year development is taken from the explicitly-stated narrative sentence. Some LOB-level splits (eg. distribution of the Ogden impact between Motor and Casualty) are not provided and have been allocated conservatively; amounts and LOB assignments below are therefore of moderate confidence.
